title: The Point Spectrum Of Periodic Quantum Trees
summary: We study the point spectrum of a periodic quantum tree equipped with a Schrödinger type differential operator with delta-type vertex conditions, using subsets of the compact graph that generates the tree. We prove analogs of existing discrete results concerning the eigenvalues of such operators (see Aomoto, 1991 and see Banks, Garza-Vargas and Mukherjee, 2022). In particular, we define the density of states measure and find the measure of eigenvalues of the periodic tree.
